# Require read permission for MV3 scripts that can inspect displayed messages

The Bug 1896522 patch changes message-display script eligibility: legacy messagesModify remains accepted, but the new route requires both messagesRead and scripting. The author noted in D210241 that scripting controls injection and that a content script can read the displayed message, so messagesRead is still required. The Manifest V3 tests switch their permission fixtures from messagesModify to messagesRead. Current ext-mail.js and scripting-tb.json retain this boundary. Review message-display injection as data access even when the test only changes CSS or a harmless DOM attribute.

Scope: Extension permissions and message display.

Paths:

- `mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-mail.js`
